description: Shared SWISH parity fixtures (C9, video-analysis-redesign step 02): synthesized signals — parameters, not bytes — that BOTH swish implementations must rank the same way. The Python runner is tests/test_swish_parity.py (synthesizes the PCM from these parameters, writes a WAV, runs swingsage.audio_impact.candidates). The Kotlin runner does not exist yet — the expo-module has no gradle test infrastructure — and is the named shortfall of this step: when it lands, it synthesizes the SAME PCM from this file and asserts the same expectations against SwingClip's swish path. Until then this file is the single statement of what both must agree on.

clips.name: whoosh_then_click
clips.description: The canonical strike: a club audibly swinging, ending in a broadband click. The candidate must land on the click.

clips.name: bare_click_loses_to_swung_click
clips.description: The discriminator swish exists for: a LOUDER bare transient (a ball dropped on the mat) versus a quieter click with a swing in front of it. The swung click must win.

clips.name: silence_answers_nothing
clips.description: Noise floor only. An empty candidate list is the required answer — never an invented strike.
